svg.aria-label: Stack grouped by purpose. SYSTEMS, services, APIs, data: Node.js, Express, FastAPI, Flask, PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL. AI, trained and served: PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenRouter, Gemini, LoRA fine-tuning, retrieval. SURFACES, web, mobile, desktop: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind, Flutter, Kotlin Multiplatform, Compose. INFRASTRUCTURE, run it, then watch it: Docker, Oracle Cloud, Cloudflare Tunnel, Redpanda, GitHub Actions, Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry. EMBEDDED, firmware and sensors: ESP32-S3, FreeRTOS, BLE, MQTT. LANGUAGES, beneath the frameworks: Python, JavaScript, Java, C, C++, Dart, Kotlin, x86 Assembly.
svg.text: GROUPED BY WHAT IT BUILDS · NOT BY WHAT IS POPULAR
